{
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "packages/features/calendar-cache/calendar-cache.repository.ts",
      "line": 176,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Cache status includes expired CalendarCache rows",
      "body": "getCacheStatusByCredentialIds groups CalendarCache rows only by credentialId and does not filter on expiresAt, while getCachedAvailability only treats rows with expiresAt >= now as valid. As a result, the connected-calendars API can report a cacheUpdatedAt timestamp for a credential whose cache entries are all expired, causing the UI to show stale cache status and offer delete actions based on invalid data. Add an expiresAt: { gte: new Date() } condition or otherwise exclude expired rows."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/calendars/connectedCalendars.handler.ts",
      "line": 28,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Handler bypasses calendar-cache factory/mock",
      "body": "connectedCalendarsHandler directly instantiates CalendarCacheRepository instead of using the cache initialization path used elsewhere, which can select a mock or disabled behavior for calendar cache. This can query the real CalendarCache table and expose cache status even in environments or feature configurations where calendar caching is supposed to be disabled or mocked, and it makes tests that rely on the mock ineffective. Use the same cache factory/abstraction used by the rest of the calendar-cache code."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/features/apps/components/CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx",
      "line": 42,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Delete-cache mutation does not refresh connected calendars data",
      "body": "The deleteCache mutation only calls the optional onSuccess prop after success; it does not invalidate trpc.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars, unlike the disconnect mutation. If the parent does not provide an onChanged handler that invalidates or refetches, the UI will continue to display the old cacheUpdatedAt value after cache deletion. Invalidate the connected-calendars query in onSuccess or onSettled."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts",
      "line": 1024,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Empty updateMany payload may not update SelectedCalendar.updatedAt",
      "body": "fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache calls SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {}) to bump SelectedCalendar.updatedAt. Passing an empty data object relies on Prisma implicitly updating timestamps and may be treated as a no-op or be fragile across Prisma versions, making the timestamp update unreliable. If this operation fails or does nothing, the intended updatedAt refresh will not happen. Use an explicit update such as { updatedAt: new Date() }."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/platform/atoms/selected-calendars/wrappers/SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper.tsx",
      "line": 70,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Empty actions container rendered when dropdown has no items",
      "body": "ConnectedCalendarList always wraps CredentialActionsDropdown in a div with fixed width and right alignment. When the dropdown returns null, for example for delegation credentials with no cache status, the empty container still occupies layout space in the card or alert actions area. Render the wrapper conditionally or move the container inside CredentialActionsDropdown so it can return nothing without leaving an empty spacer."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/features/apps/components/CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx",
      "line": 89,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Cache timestamp is formatted with hardcoded en-US locale",
      "body": "The dropdown formats cacheUpdatedAt with Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', ...), ignoring the user's locale from useLocale. Users in other locales will see a US-formatted date/time in an otherwise localized UI. Use the active locale or i18n language when constructing Intl.DateTimeFormat."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/calendars/deleteCache.handler.ts",
      "line": 25,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "api",
      "title": "Generic Error thrown for authorization or not-found case",
      "body": "deleteCacheHandler throws a plain Error('Credential not found or access denied') when the credential is missing or not owned by the user. tRPC will generally surface this as an internal error rather than a semantic FORBIDDEN or NOT_FOUND response, and it may create unnecessary server error logs. Throw a TRPCError with an appropriate code instead."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/calendars/_router.tsx",
      "line": 29,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "api",
      "title": "credentialId schema accepts any number",
      "body": "The deleteCache input uses z.number() for credentialId, which allows negative, zero, and non-integer values. Credential IDs are positive integers, so use z.number().int().positive() to reject invalid input early."
    },
    {
      "file": "scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh",
      "line": 68,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Webhook helper script uses BSD/macOS-only sed syntax",
      "body": "scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh runs sed -i '' -E ..., which is BSD/macOS syntax and is not portable to GNU sed on Linux. On Linux this can fail or create unintended backup files, preventing the script from updating GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL. Use a portable in-place edit strategy and consider resolving ../.env relative to the script location rather than the current working directory."
    },
    {
      "file": "apps/web/package.json",
      "line": 11,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "dev:cron depends on npx tsx without declaring tsx",
      "body": "The dev:cron script now invokes npx tsx cron-tester.ts, but tsx is not declared as a dependency or devDependency. npx may download it on demand or prompt interactively, making the script network-dependent and less reproducible. Add tsx to devDependencies or use an already installed runner such as ts-node."
    }
  ]
}

findings.title: Cache status includes expired CalendarCache rows
findings.body: getCacheStatusByCredentialIds groups CalendarCache rows only by credentialId and does not filter on expiresAt, while getCachedAvailability only treats rows with expiresAt >= now as valid. As a result, the connected-calendars API can report a cacheUpdatedAt timestamp for a credential whose cache entries are all expired, causing the UI to show stale cache status and offer delete actions based on invalid data. Add an expiresAt: { gte: new Date() } condition or otherwise exclude expired rows.

This can query the real CalendarCache table and expose cache status even in environments or feature configurations where calendar caching is supposed to be disabled or mocked, and it makes tests that rely on the mock ineffective. Use the same cache factory/abstraction used by the rest of the calendar-cache code.

findings.title: dev:cron depends on npx tsx without declaring tsx
findings.body: The dev:cron script now invokes npx tsx cron-tester.ts, but tsx is not declared as a dependency or devDependency. npx may download it on demand or prompt interactively, making the script network-dependent and less reproducible. Add tsx to devDependencies or use an already installed runner such as ts-node.
